finding.root_cause: structured-inspector.js caught normalization failures for persisted props.contentModel and substituted createElementContent(type). Rendering and a later edit could therefore discard the malformed saved model without an explicit recovery decision.
finding.affected_contract: structured-v1 Inspector contentModel for list, table, tabs, accordion, gallery, and carousel
finding.reproduction: A table with rows of different lengths throws from normalizeElementContent; the prior catch silently displayed a fresh default model.

change.runtime: Persisted invalid content now renders as a read-only alert with no editing fields. A separately labeled reset-to-default button is the only callback path; locked nodes cannot invoke it. Missing contentModel on legacy nodes still receives the documented default model.
tests: Added a deterministic Node regression using a minimal DOM stub to verify no mutation on render, explicit-only recovery, the exact default model and locked-node protection.
Added an end-to-end browser assertion to the existing structured Inspector Save/Publish regression for read-only warning and explicit recovery.
change.save_publish: No behavior change; reset only edits the draft through the existing callback and does not publish.
